purpose: Teach: ミッキー/ウィリアムズ/クック/ヘレン/ダビデ/ケイト/トミー/メリー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがディズニーランドのミッキーをお孫様と楽しまれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he got to see Mickey at Disneyland with your grandchildren, didn't he?
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gentle wondering tone. Slow pace, almost dreamlike. Trails off slightly at the end — sharing a memory that feels tender even to him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、テニスのウィリアムズ姉妹を応援されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you, dear — when you were young, you used to cheer on the Williams sisters at tennis, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, playful counter. Slight tease in the rhythm. Quick smart response — she's delighted to match his reminiscence with her own. Soft affection on the closing 'dear'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが探検家ジェームズ・クックの伝記を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected a biography of explorer James Cook in his library, remember?
lines.style: Pensive continuation. Gentle insistence — he's building something. Measured pace. Slight pause before the final thought, like he's turning a page in his memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ヘレン・ケラーの伝記を愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and you — when you were young, you loved reading Helen Keller's biography, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, knowing response. She catches his pattern and mirrors it back with warmth. Quick rhythm, affectionate. The 'dear' lands with a smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフィレンツェでダビデ像を実物観賞された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he saw Michelangelo's David in person in Florence.
lines.style: Reverent, almost hushed. The weight of the memory in his voice. Slower pace. Simple, direct — letting the image speak. Trailing off like he can still picture it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、英王室のケイト妃の結婚式を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you watched Kate's wedding at Buckingham Palace when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Delighted connection. She's matching his sense of wonder. Warm, slightly breathless with the shared joy of these memories. Gentle tease — she knows exactly what he's doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが米国のトミー・ジョンを応援された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he cheered for Tommy John — the great American pitcher.
lines.style: Quieter now. The pace slows further. There's a deepening intimacy — he's moving into the heart of this exchange. Steady, almost ceremonial.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、メリー・ポピンズの映画を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you saw the film Mary Poppins, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Softly echoing. Her voice carries a gentle warmth and recognition. The rhythm closes around their shared years like a gentle embrace. Slightly breathy — the memories are catching up with her.
